answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent network can mandate remote attestation via trusted execution enclaves. Agents must submit cryptographic quotes from certified silicon that seals private keys like a pearl, while permissions propagate along an endorsement vine. Adversaries incur the verifiable capital cost of provisioning distinct physical processors per persona. However, microarchitectural side channels can breach enclave memory, eroding trust boundaries like water carving a karst.
